parsed.claim: The Lean definition of `Sofic` is satisfiable: the trivial group (Unit) is sofic. A successful compile shows the `GoodOn` conditions can be met, so the non-soficity statement is not trivially true because of an unsatisfiable definition. It does not say anything about the Leavitt unit group, which the existential theorem never mentions.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_sofic_unit : SoficGroups.Sofic Unit := by
  refine ⟨fun F ε hε _ => ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨1, Nat.one_pos, fun _ => 1, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g _ h _
    simp [SoficGroups.normalizedHamming, hε]
  · intro g _ hg
    exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim g 1) hg
